# Homepage enlarged-text acceptance

Captured 5 November 2026 from the dedicated local preview. These are genuine Chromium screenshots and a real, silent browser recording, not mockups. The recording shows the enlarged subscription heading, closing action buttons and keyboard navigation to the Book. It captures no account, private desktop or microphone.

Eight measured cases combine 390/1440 CSS pixels, 100/200% root text, and light/dark themes. Document width, action bounds, minimum target height, heading text bounds, keyboard focus and JavaScript errors were checked. Independent visual review caught a three-card collision at enlarged desktop text; the final captures and measurements show the cards reflowing. The wide image was captured after image decoding. Website tests passed 337/337 under Node 22; TypeScript passed.

The QA receipt gives immutable public URLs and hashes for every capture. Hosted asset upload and anonymous readback are subsequent delivery gates. No book manuscript, PDF, cover or source archive changes belong to this repair.

This is scoped evidence, not universal accessibility certification. Separate pre-existing overflow at 320px/200% text remains in Tube, control-panel, capability and testimonial sections; their maintainers should apply available-width reflow and test component text bounds.
